description.en: Graph showing the variation of stopping potential ($V_0$) with the frequency of incident radiation ($\nu$) for two different metals A and B. The slope is $h/e$.
description.hi: दो अलग-अलग धातुओं A और B के लिए आपतित विकिरण की आवृत्ति ($\nu$) के साथ निरोधी विभव ($V_0$) के परिवर्तन को दर्शाने वाला ग्राफ। ढलान $h/e$ है।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 500 350" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Axes -->
  <line x1="50" y1="250" x2="450" y2="250" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" /> <!-- X-axis (Frequency) -->
  <line x1="100" y1="300" x2="100" y2="50" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2" /> <!-- Y-axis (Stopping Potential) -->

  <!-- Axis Labels -->
  <text x="420" y="270" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#4b5563">Frequency (ν)</text>
  <text x="20" y="40" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#4b5563">Stopping</text>
  <text x="20" y="55" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#4b5563">Potential (V₀)</text>

  <!-- Origin -->
  <text x="85" y="265" font-family="Arial" font-size="14">O</text>

  <!-- Line for Metal A -->
  <line x1="180" y1="250" x2="350" y2="80" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2" />
  <text x="355" y="75" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#ef4444">Metal A</text>

  <!-- Extrapolated line A -->
  <line x1="180" y1="250" x2="130" y2="300" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />

  <!-- Threshold frequency for Metal A -->
  <circle cx="180" cy="250" r="4" fill="#ef4444" />
  <text x="165" y="270" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#ef4444">ν₀A</text>

  <!-- Line for Metal B (Parallel to A) -->
  <line x1="280" y1="250" x2="400" y2="130" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />
  <text x="405" y="125" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#3b82f6">Metal B</text>

  <!-- Extrapolated line B -->
  <line x1="280" y1="250" x2="230" y2="300" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />

  <!-- Threshold frequency for Metal B -->
  <circle cx="280" cy="250" r="4" fill="#3b82f6" />
  <text x="265" y="270" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#3b82f6">ν₀B</text>

  <!-- Work function intercept indication -->
  <text x="45" y="295" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#4b5563">-Φ₀/e</text>

  <!-- Slope indication -->
  <path d="M230,200 L280,200 L280,150" fill="none" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="290" y="180" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#10b981">Slope = h/e</text>

</svg>
